borsh.scope: W4 owned BTreeMap; decoder/encoder lifecycle in linked handler

blubber.scope: W4 map; validated root already open, commit follows both blocks

star_frame.scope: W4 native exclusive wrapper; bulk owned replacement, including all staging and resize costs

bytemuck.scope: W1 numeric array; insert is push, capacity 1000

sokoban.scope: W2 numeric tree, capacity 1000; no variable String payload

zeropod.scope: W4 root replacement; handler also measures, resizes, revalidates, sets and trims

wincode.scope: W4 owned BTreeMap mutation; serialize/resize in linked handler

pinapod.scope: W3 old-dependent vector growth with fixed 17-byte string slots; W1 numeric push. Handler preflights, resizes when the element count changes, updates and trims

light.scope: W1 numeric vector; insert is push, runtime capacity 1000

anchor_slab.scope: W1 numeric slab; exact growth, rent prepaid, default guardrails; map/string workloads unsupported

critbit.scope: W2 projected 128-bit key, fixed capacity 1000; no variable strings

manifest.scope: W2 full 256-bit key; header snapshot h already loaded and its borrow released. The snippet includes resize, free-list allocation, insertion and header persistence; native graph trust

manifest_checked.scope: Same complete W2 insertion body; initial header load additionally calls upstream validate_red_black_tree. Initial load is excluded from both snippet counts; no variable strings

blubber_checked.scope: Uses the same operation bodies and `Headroom::Max` as the lazy fixture. Loads with `load` or `load_checked_mut` and commits mutable instructions
